description: Fetch one owned world, model, asset pack, material, material pack, Image, or video/audio asset by type and ID. Returns chatUrl, previewImageUrl, item/map descriptors, Image and video/audio readiness, capability flags, and nextSteps when available. Failed assets include failureClass, failureCode, a safe failureReason, moderationCategories when content policy labels are available, retryable, and retryGuidance. Final/provider/download asset URLs such as thumbnails, panos, meshes, material maps, Image files, audio files, direct GLB downloads, storage keys, provider IDs, and Trigger IDs are intentionally omitted.
name: get_asset
title: Get Asset
